playbookOutputs: SARS Notice of Registration (EMP) for PAYE, and UIF/SDL where applicable
Short note on first EMP201 due date and monthly obligations
playbookCommonFailures: No active registered representative on the company's SARS profile — eFiling blocks the 'Register for PAYE' request
Company income tax compliance status not in good standing (outstanding ITR14 or debt) at time of request
eFiling OTP goes to a director's cell that is not reachable, so the tax-type activation cannot be completed
Payroll start date or number of employees entered inconsistently with the SDL/UIF answers, triggering a SARS query
Client's eFiling profile is a personal profile that does not have the company organisation linked

informationToProvide.label: The registered name of the entity
informationToProvide.aiHint: Registered name exactly as on the CIPC CoR14.3, including '(Pty) Ltd'. Cross-check against the company already linked on eFiling before requesting the PAYE tax type.

informationToProvide.label: Nature of Business
informationToProvide.aiHint: Main business activity in plain words (e.g. 'plumbing contractor'). Used to pick the SIC/SETA classification on the RAV01 — never guess the SETA; if unclear, ask the client what industry body they fall under.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect eFiling credentials and payroll facts
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: eFiling username/password received, registered name and nature of business answered, payroll start date and expected number of employees captured
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask, in addition to the catalogue items: date the first salary is/was paid, expected number of employees, expected annual payroll (SDL applies once total annual remuneration exceeds R500 000 — ⚠ verify threshold still current), and whether UIF registration is also wanted. Tell the client that SARS may send an OTP to the registered representative's cell during activation and that they must be reachable. Do not promise faster than 1-2 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Check registered representative and compliance status on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Company has an active registered representative and no compliance blocks on the income tax type
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Log in to the client's eFiling profile; confirm the company (organisation) is linked and that the Registered Representative shows as active under SARS Registered Details. If there is no active representative, stop and propose the Tax Representative Appointment service — SARS will not activate a new tax type without one. Also open Tax Status > Tax Compliance Status; if non-compliant, draft a client message listing what is outstanding. Never attempt to solve OTP or CAPTCHA prompts — hand off to Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify entity details against CIPC and SARS records
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Registered name, registration number and trading address on eFiling match the CoR14.3 and the order's entity
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: The entity is the employer company, not the ordering contact. If the eFiling registered details differ from the CoR14.3 (name change, address), flag it — the RAV01 must be corrected first or SARS rejects the tax-type request.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare RAV01 / PAYE registration hand-off sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet lists every field value for the 'Register for PAYE' screen and is posted for Kevin's review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Fields: registered name, registration number, income tax number, payroll start date (liability date), number of employees, estimated annual payroll, SDL yes/no with reason, UIF yes/no, SETA classification, business address, banking details already on SARS record. Leave anything unknown blank and flag it — never invent a liability date; SARS back-dates penalties to it.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit PAYE registration on eFiling (RAV01 – Register for PAYE)
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: PAYE (and UIF/SDL where selected) tax type requested and SARS confirmation or reference visible
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Path: SARS Registered Details > Maintain SARS Registered Details (RAV01) > Employer tab / 'Register for PAYE'. Stage all values from the hand-off sheet, take a screenshot of the completed screens and stop for Kevin to press submit. Registration is usually immediate; if SARS asks for supporting documents (proof of address, ID of representative) create a proposal with the exact list. Record the 7-series PAYE reference the moment it appears.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for SARS Notice of Registration
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Notice of Registration for PAYE downloaded from eFiling (Notices > Notice of Registration)
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: If no notice after 2 working days, check the eFiling work page for a 'supporting documents required' status before contacting the SARS Contact Centre. Log every SARS case number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver PAYE reference number and Notice of Registration
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: PAYE reference, notice and first-EMP201 guidance posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain in plain English: EMP201 is due by the 7th of the following month (earlier if the 7th falls on a weekend/holiday), payslips must show the PAYE reference, and EMP501 reconciliations fall in April/May and October/November. Offer the monthly EMP201 service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
